content:
RPS' regular ritual of sharing the games we’re playing this weekend has taken a slightly unsettling turn, now that this year’s Advent Calendar Guessing Game is up and running and victory-hungry game taste estimators – you know who you are! – have begun combing them for hints at our Gee-Oh-Tee-Why picks. It feels like we’re being watched. Which, if you’re wondering how that differs from our usual state of being read, is colder, and a little bit chalkier.
Still, maybe I can throw some of 'em off. Gosh, wasn’t I Am Jesus Christ a banger? April’s best, by far. They gone? Okay, here’s what we’re actually playing.
Edwin:
This weekend I will be playing a game that rhymes three times with door. There might be a nice review in it for you, if we're lucky, but at the very least a chunky impressions piece.
Mark:
It's more GTA 6 for me. I'm in chapter three and feel like I might spend about 50 more hours robbing places, buying stuff, and exploring Leonida before I eventually get back on with the story. I got through the first two chapters at a decent pace, so have deliberately slowed it down to try and get a fuller picture of what the game has to offer. I say that, I can't guarantee I won't be lured back into story jobs by the end of Sunday.
James:
I’m going to play a bit of nicely tactile codebreaking sim TR-49 and repeatedly checking the Days Until Sea of Sorrow sign I put up, in the hope of making the number go lower by looking at it.
Jeremy:
I've been so busy editing our excellent freelancers' GTA 6 guides (shout out to all of them; scroll down on the main page to see their good work) that I need to actually sit and play the game a bit further myself. Though I doubt I'll have much time this weekend, as other real-life responsibilities are calling. Ah well. At least I managed to steal the Hauners P-996 Lazer early on.
Ollie:
If I might be so bold, I might try to find time to play something that isn't GTA this weekend. I've been meaning to dip back into Age of Empires IV recently, so maybe I'll have a go at the campaign, ease myself back into the idea of Other Games.
Julian, Callum and Dion aren't in their drawer, even though I'm sure I left them there last time.
And you, reader dear, what are you playing this weekend?...
